_note: Each part's cover (kit/hc.js covers()): the drawing (assets/illustrations/<name>.svg; a name not in index.json yet falls back to the template's own data-illo) and the plate's tint (blush · lavender · butter · mint, hc.css [data-tint]). Keyed by data-part, so renumbering the stages never moves a cover. Order here is talk order. "flip": true mirrors a drawing whose figure stands at its right edge, so the oversized figure lands next to the words.
